{{Current events|year=2019|month=09|day=21|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Iran–Saudi Arabia proxy conflict]]
**[[2019 Abqaiq–Khurais attack]]
***Saudi Foreign Minister [[Adel al-Jubeir]] says the international community must take a firm stand on [[Tehran]] and that if confirmed [[Iran]] is behind the attacks against the oil facilities, [[Saudi Arabia]] will "take the necessary steps" to "respond appropriately". [https://www.reuters.com/article/saudi-aramco-jubeir/saudi-says-it-will-respond-appropriately-if-probe-confirms-irans-role-in-attacks-idUSB2N24901D (Reuters)]
*[[2019 Karbala bombing]]
**[[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] claims responsibility for yesterday's bombing in [[Iraq]], in which 12 were killed. [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/09/21/world/middleeast/islamic-state-bus-bomb-iraq.html (''The New York Times'')]
;Disasters and accidents
*[[Search and rescue]] operations begin for a baby who is missing after a migrant boat carrying fourteen people sinks near [[Turkey]]. [https://www.dailysabah.com/turkey/2019/09/21/baby-missing-after-boat-carrying-14-migrants-sinks (The Daily Sabah)]
*Authorities in [[Texas]] report a fifth death from [[Tropical Storm Imelda]]. [https://www.latimes.com/world-nation/story/2019-09-21/florida-mans-death-is-5th-linked-to-imeldas-aftermath (Los Angeles Times)]
*[[Venezuelan migrant crisis]]
**As the number of refugees from the [[crisis in Venezuela]] is projected to surpass the 6 million figure in 2020, matching that of the [[Syrian Civil War]] now, [[Brookings Institution]] calculates that aid for Venezuelan emigration is yet only 1.5% that for Syrian emigrants after five years of crisis. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2019-09-20/venezuela-exodus-as-big-as-syria-s-got-1-5-of-the-aid-chart (Bloomberg)]
;Health and environment
*[[Climate change]] protesters glue themselves to a road near the [[Port of Dover]] in [[England]], blocking it. Police arrest ten people, believed to be members of [[Extinction Rebellion]]. Further scheduled protests take place in a dedicated area set up by police. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-kent-49780966 (BBC)]
;International relations
*[[2019 Persian Gulf crisis]]
**Iran's [[Revolutionary Guards]] leader, [[Hossein Salami]], warns that "any country that attacks the Islamic Republic will have their mainland turned into the main battlefield". He further added that "any attack will not stop until the full destruction of the aggressor". [https://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/middle-east/2019/09/21/IRGC-chief-warns-any-country-that-attacks-Iran-will-be-main-battlefield-.html (Al Arabiya English)]
;Law and crime
*[[Terrorism in Turkey]]
**[[Turkey|Turkish]] authorities declare a forest [[wildfire]] near [[Istanbul]] to be the result of [[terrorism in Turkey|terrorism]]. They say a suspect is in custody. [https://www.dailysabah.com/war-on-terror/2019/09/21/forest-fire-in-istanbul-district-terror-related-minister-says (The Daily Sabah)]
*A [[mass shooting]] in [[Lancaster, South Carolina]], leaves 2 men dead and 9 other people injured. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2019/09/21/south-carolina-shooting-leaves-2-dead-9-injured-lancaster-bar/2400844001/ (USA Today)]
;Politics and elections
*[[Brexit]]
**Thousands of protestors march in [[Edinburgh]], [[Scotland]], against the upcoming departure of the [[United Kingdom]] from the [[European Union]]. The crowd is addressed by [[Member of Parliament (United Kingdom)|Members of the UK Parliament]], and [[Members of the Scottish Parliament]]. Amongst the attendees is MSP [[Joanna Cherry]] [[QC]], who is taking legal action against [[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|UK Prime Minister]] [[Boris Johnson]]'s recent [[Prorogation in the United Kingdom#Boris Johnson (2019)|prorogation]] of the [[Parliament of the United Kingdom|UK Parliament]]. Cherry's action succeeded at Scotland's [[Court of Session]], and is currently being reviewed by the [[Supreme Court of the United Kingdom|UK Supreme Court]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-scotland-scotland-politics-49781535 (BBC)]
